name: 14422-visionprefill-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier
parallelism: tp1, pp1, dp1 -- a 7B model at bf16 needs no sharding on an 80 GB card.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, ~16 GB of weights; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 512 requests with a 1200 s safety cap.
workload: Single-turn chat, one 560x560 random-noise JPEG at quality 85 plus 128 text tokens per request, 32 output tokens with ignore_eos. ~530 prompt tokens, of which 400 are vision.
purpose: A visual question-answering assistant on a 7B vision model, serving 32 concurrent single-image queries with brief answers on one GPU.
launch:
# One H100 serving a 7B vision-language model over the OpenAI chat endpoint, 32 requests in
# flight, each carrying one 560x560 JPEG plus ~128 text tokens and generating 32.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- the reader takes this file line by line and SKIPS indented lines,
# so a value re-flowed into a nested block is dropped and the engine starts without it.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct
tp-size: 1

enable-multimodal: true
attention-backend: fa3
mm-attention-backend: fa3

mem-fraction-static: 0.7
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
disable-radix-cache: true
